query:
insert into graph_vertices (id, tenant_id, graph, kind, key, label)
        select (substring(replace($1::uuid::text, '-', '') from 1 for 16)
                || lpad(to_hex(n), 16, '0'))::uuid,
               $1, 'entity', 'person', 'v' || n, 'v' || n
        from generate_series(1::bigint, $2::bigint) n
